cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Tell the committee we're considering the festival bid. Just the announcement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Once they've reserved the date, we'll have something worth protecting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I prefer starting with the consequence that encourages us.
